[package]
name = "onenote_parser"
readme = "../../README.md"
description = "A parser for Microsoft OneNote® files"
keywords = ["onenote", "parser"]
categories = ["parser-implementations"]
exclude = ["/tests", "/benches"]
version = "2.0.0"
authors = ["Markus Siemens <markus@m-siemens.de>"]
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.85"
license = "MPL-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/msiemens/onenote.rs"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true

[features]
default = ["native-fs"]
backtrace = []
native-fs = []
onepkg = ["dep:cab"]

[dependencies]
bytes = "1.11"
encoding_rs = "0.8"
enum-primitive-derive = "0.3"
itertools = "0.14"
log = "0.4"
num-traits = "0.2"
sanitize-filename = "0.6"
thiserror = "2.0"
uuid = "1.19"
widestring = "1.2"
lru = "0.18"
typed-path = "0.12.3"

[dependencies.time]
version = "0.3"
features = ["macros"]

[dependencies.onenote_parser-macros]
version = "=2.0.0"
path = "crates/parser-macros"

[dependencies.cab]
version = "0.6"
optional = true

[dev-dependencies]
bytes = "1.11"
insta = "1.45"
tempfile = "3.15"
yare = "3.0.0"

[dev-dependencies.criterion]
version = "0.7"
default-features = false
features = ["cargo_bench_support"]

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib", "lib"]

[[bench]]
name = "parse"
harness = false

[package]
name = "onenote_parser-macros"
description = "Internal derive macros used by onenote_parser for binary parsing"
version = "2.0.0"
authors = ["Markus Siemens <markus@m-siemens.de>"]
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.85"
license = "MPL-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/msiemens/onenote.rs"

[dependencies]
quote = "1.0"
proc-macro2 = "1.0"

[dependencies.syn]
version = "2.0"
features = ["full"]

[lib]
proc-macro = true
